Abu Dabbab – Turtles & Snorkeling

Discover Abu Dabbab Bay with two guided snorkeling sessions and a relaxing beach break in between. Look for sea turtles and explore the beautiful marine life of the Red Sea.

€45 / adult
Turtles · Reefs · Two Snorkeling Sessions
View trip details

Trip details

  • Hotel pick-up and return transfer.
  • Arrival at Abu Dabbab Bay.
  • Two snorkeling sessions to explore the bay and its underwater scenery.
  • A relaxing break between the two sessions to rest, enjoy the beach and recharge before returning to the water.
  • Opportunity to spot sea turtles in their natural environment.
  • Discover colorful fish, seagrass meadows and beautiful underwater scenery.
  • Professional snorkeling guide.
  • Snorkeling equipment available upon request.
  • Photos and videos available as an optional extra.

About Abu Dabbab

Abu Dabbab is one of Marsa Alam’s best-known bays, loved for its sandy beach, seagrass meadows and rich marine life. Sea turtles are often spotted in the bay, and with luck you may also encounter a dugong. Wildlife sightings can never be guaranteed.

A relaxed snorkeling experience

Enjoy your first snorkeling session, take time to relax on the beach, and then head back into the water for a second opportunity to discover the bay. This trip is a lovely choice for nature lovers, couples, families and anyone who wants to explore the Red Sea at a comfortable pace.

Come for the turtles, stay for the beauty of the Red Sea! 🐢💙

Samadai – Dolphin House

A convenient dolphin trip from Marsa Alam Marina, with two snorkeling stops: the dolphin lagoon and a beautiful coral reef.

Ask for price
Dolphins · Coral Reef · Easy Access
View trip details

Trip details

  • Departure from Marsa Alam Marina, close to Marsa Alam town.
  • Optional transfer from your hotel.
  • Departure around 8:00 AM and return around 3:00 PM (timing may vary).
  • Two snorkeling stops: one at the Dolphin Lagoon and one at the coral reef.
  • Snorkeling equipment included: mask, fins and snorkel.
  • Life jacket is mandatory while snorkeling with dolphins in the protected Samadai reserve. Follow your guide and reserve rules at all times.
  • Professional snorkeling guide.
  • Soft drinks and lunch on the boat.
  • Photos and videos available as an optional extra.

About Samadai

Samadai is one of Egypt’s best-known dolphin areas. Spinner dolphins live in their natural environment and may sometimes swim close to snorkelers, but sightings and close encounters are never guaranteed. As this is a protected natural reserve, we follow the rules to help keep the dolphins safe.

Samadai or Sataya — which trip is right for you?

Samadai: Easier access from Marsa Alam Marina, with a shorter journey and two different stops: the dolphin lagoon and a coral reef. A great choice if you prefer a more convenient sea trip.

Sataya: A longer full-day adventure. It starts from Hamata Marina (about 1.5 hours by car from Marsa Alam), followed by around 2 hours by boat to the large lagoon, with 2–3 snorkeling sessions.

Please note: Both trips take place in the dolphins’ natural environment, so dolphins are not guaranteed. Life-jacket requirements depend on the reserve rules, guide instructions and sea conditions.

Beautiful for families, beginners and dolphin lovers. 🐬💙

Sataya Dolphin Reef

Spend an unforgettable day swimming and snorkeling with wild dolphins in their natural habitat, with beautiful coral reefs and a full-day boat adventure.

€70 / adult
Dolphins · Full day
View trip details

Trip details

  • Transfer from your hotel to Hamata Marina (about 1.5 hours by car from Marsa Alam).
  • Boat journey to Sataya takes around 2 hours.
  • Swimming and snorkeling opportunities with wild dolphins in their natural habitat (sightings are not guaranteed).
  • Beautiful coral reef snorkeling.
  • Snorkeling equipment included: mask, snorkel and fins.
  • Professional guide, lunch and drinks on the boat.
  • Photos and videos available as an optional extra.

About Sataya

Sataya is famous for its large groups of spinner dolphins. They may swim nearby, offering a memorable snorkeling experience in clear water. Dolphin sightings and interactions are not guaranteed; please follow your guide’s instructions and respect the animals. Life jackets are available and should be used whenever required by your guide or conditions.

Perfect for dolphin lovers looking for a full-day sea adventure. 🐬🌊

Marsa Mubarak Trip – Dugong & Turtles

Enjoy a relaxing snorkeling trip in one of Marsa Alam’s best-known bays for sea turtles and possible dugong encounters. Ideal for families, beginners and anyone who loves calm lagoon snorkeling.

€50 / adult
Dugong · Turtles · Snorkeling
View trip details

Trip details

  • Departure from Port Ghalib Marina
  • Only 20–25 minutes by boat to reach the bay
  • Two snorkeling sessions in the lagoon
  • Very high chance of seeing turtles, but wildlife sightings can never be guaranteed
  • With luck, you may also encounter a dugong
  • Snorkeling equipment included: mask, fins and snorkel
  • Professional snorkeling guide
  • Soft drinks and lunch on the boat
  • Optional photos and videos available

About Marsa Mubarak

Marsa Mubarak is a natural bay with seagrass, an important food source for turtles and dugongs. These animals may sometimes be seen nearby in clear water. The short boat ride and relaxed snorkeling make this a great option for families, beginners and anyone looking for an easy half-day experience.

🏝️

Hamata Islands

A full-day snorkeling adventure from Hamata, visiting Sial Island, Umm Sheikh Island and the lagoon at Al Agouna.

€65 / adult
3 Snorkeling Spots · Islands · Reefs
View trip details

Trip details

  • Hotel pick-up and transfer to Hamata Marina.
  • Departure from Hamata Marina for a full-day boat trip.
  • Visit three snorkeling locations: Sial Island, Umm Sheikh Island and the lagoon (Al Agouna).
  • Snorkeling equipment included: mask, fins and snorkel.
  • Professional snorkeling guide.
  • Lunch and soft drinks on the boat.
  • Photos and videos available as an optional extra.
  • Return to Hamata Marina and transfer back to your hotel.

Stops on the trip

1. Sial Island: Crystal-clear water, beautiful coral reefs, snorkeling and free time on the island — ideal for photos.

2. Umm Sheikh Island: A snorkeling stop known for colorful reefs and lots of fish.

3. The Lagoon (Al Agouna): Another snorkeling stop with calm, shallow areas and good visibility when conditions allow.

What makes it special?

Enjoy natural islands, beautiful reefs and several snorkeling spots away from the usual crowded locations. A lovely choice for families, couples and nature lovers. The itinerary and conditions can vary with weather and sea conditions.
